quotes.author: Megan Kappes
quotes.text: Where do I start?? As my two young men and husband said, this Alaska Wild Guides Jet Ski adventure through the glaciers was EPIC and THE highlight of our vacation in Alaska. I researched this once in a lifetime trip for over a year and from the moment I found Alaska Wild Guides jet ski glacier tour, I knew this would be like nothing else. Boat tour to glaciers pale in comparison and can’t get you to literally be able to touch the ice and buzzing past waterfalls to where you can feel the water spray! Bryce is an amazing guide and single handily got the biggest tip I ever gave in my world adventures because he earned it. Don’t hesitate, it is worth every penny!

quotes.author: Diane Hirshberg
quotes.text: We had a great time jet skiing to Blackstone Bay! The guide was fabulous-nursed us jet skiing novices along until we could crank it up and guided us to some gorgeous spots to get some great pics. So fun!

quotes.author: Kathryn Aispuro
quotes.text: The jet ski tour was the most amazing thing I have ever done! The guide was great and very reassuring (I was really scared at first) and the scenery is spectacular. So, so great!!!

quotes.author: William Sidney
quotes.text: Out standing weather , an the leader

Jet skiing to the glaciers was one of the most breathtaking experiences. Our guide, Bryce, was extremely informative and did an excellent job guiding us through the bays. Highly recommend this trip and this touring company!
